summary: Steel lookout tower built about 1936 near Sugar Grove, Fairfield County, Ohio; NHLR-registered 2014; planned move to Alley Park, current location unconfirmed.

facts.design: steel tower with a 7 by 7 foot cab; 100 feet in 1937 and 1958 newspapers, 110 feet in NHLR and a 2017 newspaper item
facts.status_note: Described as standing on private land in 2017; a move to Charles F. Alley Memorial Park was planned, and no source confirms it happened

staffing.status: watch staffed per newspapers through 1963; no later staffing record found

access.note: On private land per 2017 Ohio chapter report; no public visiting information found

facts.agency: Ohio Department of Natural Resources (former owner, per 2017 Ohio chapter report)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Newspapers from 1937 and 1958 say 100 feet; NHLR (2014) and a 2017 newspaper item say 110 feet. The story reports both and does not choose.
A 1977 item says title moved between state agencies to Hocking Technical College; a 2017 report calls it a former ODNR tower on private land. Both are reported without reconciling.

notes_for_editor: Height is left out of facts, and no height correction is proposed. The 100 ft figures (1937, 1958) and 110 ft figures (NHLR 2014, 2017 newspaper) are both total heights, and no source gives the cab-floor height that height_m means. The record's 30.5 m matches the 100 ft figure, so the editor should decide which height the record carries. Current location after 2017 is unconfirmed. The tower's Facebook page (Sugar Grove Fire Tower - Ohio) describes a move to Alley Park but its text could not be read and is undated, so it is not cited. The 2017 Eagle-Gazette article returned HTTP 403; its text is cited through the Forest Lookouts transcription. The 1963 Berne Township watchwoman item is assumed to concern this tower because the transcription files it under Sugar Grove and the 2017 report places the tower in Berne Township. No staffing record after 1963 was found.
